'''Kontor''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Doctor/Legends|doctor]] [[Botanist/Legends|botanist]] who was leading the research team<ref name="frostbloom sweep">{{TORcite|Frostbloom Sweep|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> at the [[Glacial Trespass]] area of the [[Jannimak crash site|''Jannimak'' crash site]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]<ref name="Glacial">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=location|[[Glacial Trespass]]|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]}}</ref>  around [[3622 BBY]].<ref name="Date">{{TOR_updates|7.8}}</ref>

==Glacial Trespass reserch==
Kontor's observations at the [[Glacial Trespass]] led him to believe that the main factor in area's drastic drop of temperature was thermal-dampening flora, including [[Frostbloom|frostblooms]]<ref name="frostbloom sweep" /> and [[Resonating Frostbulb|frostbulb]].<ref name="hollow frost" /> Ignoring the findings of his colleague [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maniks]], who noticed a symbiotic relationship between these flora and frost-loving creatures from [[Jannimak]], Kontor hastily sent [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]]'s contractors to cull the plants, which resulted in the subsequent aggressive response from cryophilic fauna.<ref name="frigid swarm">{{TORcite|Frigid Swarm|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> This development came to Kontor's surprise; swarming hordes of cryo-nesters attacked not only [[Galactic Sustainability Institute|GSI]] contractors,<ref name="frigid swarm" /> but soon the forward camp where Kontor was stationed as well, nearly destroying his research and his sample collection.<ref name="outpost defense">{{TORcite|Outpost Defense|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> Later, observing [[Gladiopod|gladiopods]] defending [[Resonating Frostbulb|thermal-dampening flora]] as well, Kontor started considering [[Maniks]]'s symbiotic theory more plausible.<ref name="hollow frost">{{TORcite|Hollow Frost|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref>

==Other interests==
Despite fungi being outside of his expertise,<ref name="fungal protection">{{TORcite|Fungal Protection|[[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]|exp=lots|type=dynamic}}</ref> Doctor Kontor became interested in preserving a species of an [[ancient Dantooinian fungus]] found to be thriving in the caves of the newly [[Terraforming/Legends|transformed]] environment of [[Geothermal Disruption]]. He instructed [[Galactic Sustainability Institute]]'s contractors to defend the fungi from fungivorous [[Geo Beast|Geo beast]] [[Larva/Legends|larvae]], and collect spore samples for preservation.<ref name="fungal protection" />

==Relationship with colleges==
In his personal [[Datapad/Legends|datapads]], Doctor Kontor wrote performance evaluations of three other researchers initially assigned to his team. These included:
*[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Spears]], whose antisocial tendencies and complete disregard for authority made Kontor personally avoid him and reassign him to Doctor [[Edreck]]'s team at the [[Sporefall]] area.<ref name="datapad1">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Datapad "Perfomance Evaluations" located at the forward camp at [[Glacial Trespass]]}}</ref>

*[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Maniks]], whom Kontor initially considered too "meddlesome" and too focused on "making friends instead of sample collection",<ref name="datapad1" /> but who later got his respect for committing herself to work.<ref name="datapad2">{{TORcite|exp=lots|type=other|Datapad "Project Updates" located at the forward camp at [[Glacial Trespass]]}}</ref> However her especial interest in [[Cryo-nester|cryo-nesters]], which Kontor considered outside the primary mission priorities, complicated their collaboration.<ref name="Glacial" /><ref name="datapad2" />

*[[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] [[Sanner]], whose sample cataloguing methods and appreciation for botanical sciences highly impressed Kontor.<ref name="datapad1" /> She shared his position on the role of flora in the area, and wanted to participate in the field research of the ecosystem, but Kontor stopped her, fearing for her safety.<ref name="datapad2" /> He noted to himself to inquire what kinds of flowers does she like, thinking of getting her some and leaning towards choosing a [[Banalilium]].<ref name="datapad1" />

==Behind the scenes==
Kontor first appeared in Game Update 7.8: ''Pursuit of Ruin'', released on [[December 9]], [[2025]], as part of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Legacy of the Sith]]'',<ref name="Pursuit of Ruin">{{TORweb|url=info/news/%5Bnews-category%5D/20251209-2|text=Game Update 7.8 "Pursuit of Ruin" is now live!}}</ref> the eighth digital expansion to the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Announcement">{{TORweb|url=info/news/article/20210701|text=Announcing Legacy of the Sith, the next expansion for Star Wars: The Old Republic}}</ref>
